scope: Cross-session PRUNE collar values manually checked against the five sibling ledgers available on 2026-10-23. Exact (AXIS, value) reuse prohibited. Numeric cutoff values with any refill policy are treated as occupied, a stricter rule than literal string matching.
interpretation: The selected numerical cutoffs are absent from all five fetched ledgers; all three are PRUNE tests with fixed count and the same FIFO-BFS H19-5 refill rule. Existing 3.61/4/5 no-refill and 3.0 refill are distinct values and are not recreated. This is a best-effort owner-repo audit, not proof of every submission ever made by the entity.

snap_audit.basis_for_novelty: The three new arms combine three constraints in one rule: (a) displacement restricted to within 45 deg of the local fault normal estimated from the parent dot set, (b) destination score = mean of rank-normalised tmi_hg and iso_grav_anom_hg (two independent supplied gradient bands), (c) minimum 2.0 px separation from every other dot. No sibling ledger records an arm with (a) anisotropic cross-strike search; the closest recorded arms are isotropic 2 px searches on a single edge band or a plain pair-consensus.
snap_audit.limits: Novelty was assessed from recorded ledger value strings, not by reading every sibling implementation. A sibling may implement a similar rule under a different label. This is a best-effort audit, not proof of the entity's complete submission history.
